tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is far beyond the pilot window, leaving the slow timescale and reversal genuinely ambiguous. The recommended slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the competing mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify the slow component or distinguish the proposed adaptation mechanisms at H=21.7.
Additional fine short-horizon measurements are less directly informative about the slow reversal.
The slow-horizon probe can distinguish this candidate from endogenous adaptation.
